content.title: Real American Freestyle 06 - Mullett Arena ASU
content.text: Skip to content Saturday, February 28, 2026 Real American Freestyle 06 Share EVENT INFO Real American Freestyle (RAF), the first unscripted professional freestyle wrestling league will be taking place February 28 at Mullett Arena in Tempe, Arizona at 7:00 PM MT. MMA Champion and Olympic gold medalist Henry Cejudo and combat sports legend Clay Guida will co-headline RAF06. Opponents for both Cejudo and Guida will be announced in the coming weeks, along with additional bouts rounding out the RAF06 card. RAF06 will stream exclusively on FOX Nation.
